Refurbished Apple iPhone 13 Pro

When you purchase the refurbished Apple iPhone 13 Pro on Cashify, which offers the best quality of refurbished phones at budget-friendly prices. Cashify ensures the refurbished phones are up to the mark.

It has a sizable 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display with a 2532 x 1170 pixel resolution. This smartphone includes a 3825mAh Lithium-Ion battery, which gives you the power to work, play games, and view videos for a long time. It supports Qi wireless charging at 7.5W and MagSafe wireless charging at 15W.

The Refurbished Apple iPhone 13 Pro at Cashify passes through 32 Points Quality Check. Therefore, you don't need to worry about the phone's quality. You will also get a 6-months warranty on the smartphone bought from Cashify. The warranty is applicable for six months beginning from the invoice date. Cashify even offers EMI options and free home delivery.

This smartphone's A15 Bionic chip, which has a new 6-core CPU with 2-speed cores and four efficiency cores, makes it simple to operate several programmes.

You have sensor-shift stabilization for the primary camera and can now shoot macro pictures for the first time with up to 3X optical zoom.

The new A15 Bionic SoC performs exceptionally well. Storage capacity can reach 1TB, although the most expensive model is limited. The 120Hz ProMotion display has significantly improved but still has a distracting notch. The stereo speakers are also fairly decent, with outstanding construction quality.

For considerably more imaginative storytelling, the cinematic mode may also foresee when a significant new subject is about to enter the screen and bring it into focus.

Cashify ensures that the Refurbished iPhone 13 Pro is usable as Cashify sells only high-quality products. Meanwhile, the Refurbished iPhone 13 Pro at Cashify is like a new one but at a lower price.

  • RAM: 6GB
  • ROM: 128GB/256GB/512GB/1TB
